title: DriftGuard: Online Memory-Drift Detection via Causal Attribution for LLM Agents
title_zh: DriftGuard：基于因果归因的 LLM 智能体在线记忆漂移检测
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on persistent memory to plan tool calls and complete multi-step tasks, which exposes them to memory drift: an adversarial or misleading memory alters the execution path and final outcome. In this work, we investigate online memory-drift detection, which estimates each retrieved memory's causal contribution to potential drift at serving time. We identify two fundamental challenges. (1) Content-level features are insufficient for causal memory-drift attribution, as perplexity or retrieval relevance alone cannot determine which retrieved memory would change agent behavior if neutralized; (2) Counterfactual attribution is prohibitively expensive for online detection, as it requires replaying downstream agent and tool execution for each candidate memory, exceeding real-time serving budgets. To address these challenges, we propose DriftGuard, a two-stage framework that decouples offline causal supervision from online estimation. Specifically, DriftGuard first constructs causal supervision through repeated paired counterfactual replays, continuing the original and single-memory neutralized trajectory suffixes from a shared pre-action state. The resulting annotations are aggregated by component-wise majority voting into a memory drift score (MDS) that captures action change, attack removal, violation removal, and task recovery. Guided by this supervision, DriftGuard then learns an online risk model that estimates MDS from pre-action information and flags drift-inducing memories via its maximum component risk, without online counterfactual rollouts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DriftGuard accurately identifies drift-inducing memories and enables efficient online defense. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DriftGuard-7F0B.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖持久记忆规划工具调用并完成多步任务，但对抗性或误导性记忆可能改变执行路径和最终结果，造成记忆漂移。论文研究如何在服务时估计每条检索记忆对漂移的因果贡献。困惑度和检索相关性等内容指标无法判断中和某条记忆后智能体的行为是否会改变，而逐条重放后续智能体轨迹和工具调用又超出实时服务预算。为此，DriftGuard 将离线因果监督与在线风险估计分离：离线从同一行动前状态出发，反复成对重放原始轨迹和中和单条记忆后的轨迹，并对各维度的结果分别进行多数投票，得到记忆漂移分数（MDS），涵盖动作变化、攻击消除、违规消除和任务恢复。在线风险模型仅利用行动前可获得的信息估计 MDS，并依据风险最高的维度标记可能引发漂移的记忆，无须执行反事实重放。实验表明，DriftGuard 能准确识别引发漂移的记忆，同时支持高效的在线防御。
key_points_zh: 困惑度和检索相关性不能回答因果问题：中和哪条记忆会改变智能体行为？
离线从同一行动前状态成对重放原始轨迹与单条记忆被中和后的轨迹，构造因果监督信号。
记忆漂移分数（MDS）通过逐维多数投票汇总动作变化、攻击消除、违规消除和任务恢复。
在线模型仅使用行动前信息预测各维度风险，以最高风险标记记忆，避免重放下游轨迹和工具调用。
